text:
invoice-bot: New invoice received from Cobalt Labs: INV-CB-907 for $9,250. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/INV-CB-907. Vendor referenced PO: PO-9924. Auto-extracted GL: 4503. Flag: one line item unassigned to PO. Please review.

megan_fin: Checked PDF — two lines: Software license $6,750 (PO-9924), Integration services $2,500 (no PO). Invoice due in 10 days.

tom_proc: Procurement did not issue a separate PO for integration. Was this part of a change order?

sean_eng: Integration work was approved verbally by eng manager but we didn't create a PO. Ops expects a separate PO for services.

rachel_ap: AP won't code the $2.5k without PO or documented approval. Options: 1) request vendor reissue with new PO number, 2) create internal PO and ask vendor to reissue, 3) post with manual coding + approval override.

procurement-bot: Note: creating an internal PO after-the-fact requires PR and manager approval. Vendor reissue preferred for audit trail.

megan_fin: I'll email vendor requesting reissue referencing new PO if Procurement creates it. If vendor cannot reissue within 24h we take override path.

vendor-bot: Auto-reply from Cobalt Labs: "We can reissue only if you send a PO number to billing@cobalt.com. We cannot edit an invoice once it's been finalized in our system"

tom_proc: I'll open PR-904 and route for expedited approval to produce PO-9925 for integration services. ETA 5 hours.

sean_eng: If Procurement needs a quick sign-off, I can approve PO-9925 once created.

megan_fin: Great. Megan will hold AP processing until either vendor reissues or we have PO-9925 and vendor confirmation. AP ticket AP-5012 created.

rachel_ap: Marking invoice on hold: HOLD-PO-MISSING. Will not schedule payment run until AP notified.

procurement-bot: PR-904 created. PO-9925 pending approvals.

vendor-bot: Vendor note received: "Please send PO-9925 to billing@cobalt.com once available and we will reissue INV-CB-907."

tom_proc: PO-9925 created and routed. Tagged @sean_eng for approval.

sean_eng: Approved PO-9925.

procurement-bot: PO-9925 is live and linked to PR-904. Notifying vendor to reissue.

megan_fin: Emailed billing@cobalt.com with PO-9925 copy and requested reissued invoice. Will update AP-5012 when vendor confirms.

vendor-bot: Cobalt replies: "Reissued invoice INV-CB-907-R1 now available. Includes PO-9924 and PO-9925. Sending PDF."

rachel_ap: Received reissued invoice. Removing HOLD-PO-MISSING. Posting payments as split lines to their respective POs. AP-5012 closed.

megan_fin: Thanks team — audit note: "Vendor reissued invoice to include new PO-9925 per procurement request. Attached emails and PO snapshot to AP ticket." Closing thread."
